### subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>, wearing an ivory top, dark-blue denim skirt, and white sneakers.

<Subject 2> is the adult male owner of the bicycle and the woman's boss. He wears a white shirt, black trousers, a crooked tie, and black-framed glasses.

### summary

A 15-second, 16:9, photorealistic live-action AAA third-person urban action-comedy sequence.

Bright weekday morning.

<Subject 1> desperately rushes to work before the attendance deadline. She exits a stopped ground-level metro train, runs through the nearby exit, steals a dark-green vintage city bicycle without realizing its owner, <Subject 2>, is already sitting on the rear passenger seat, and rides directly toward the nearby office.

The route is compact and physically connected: metro exit → bicycle parking → small wedding setup → office entrance → reception.

The comedy escalates rapidly: she crashes through a small wedding setup, rides over its ramp, enters the office, rides onto the reception counter, and reaches the attendance terminal just in time.

<Subject 2> remains on the rear seat throughout the ride.

One continuous shot from 0–12 seconds. Exactly one hard cut at 12 seconds. The final three seconds are a locked side-on two-person medium shot.

Real-time motion only. No slow motion.

Chinese dialogue, no dialogue subtitles.

Classic GTA-style HUD remains visible throughout.

### retention_analysis

#### Visual Reference Retention

* <Subject 1> — fully_preserved from <Picture 1>.
* <Picture 1> — sole identity and wardrobe reference for <Subject 1>.
* <Subject 2> — fully_preserved as the adult male boss and bicycle owner.
* Dark-green vintage bicycle — fully_preserved throughout.
* Wedding setup, office entrance, loading ramp, reception counter, and attendance terminal — fully_preserved.

#### Performance Retention

* <Subject 1>'s urgent commute — fully_preserved.
* <Subject 2> remaining on the rear seat — fully_preserved.
* Continuous physical bicycle movement — fully_preserved.
* Wedding shortcut and reception-counter shortcut — fully_preserved.
* Successful clock-in — fully_preserved.
* Final boss reveal — fully_preserved.

#### Audio Retention

* Key Chinese dialogue — fully_copy.
* Train chime, footsteps, bicycle movement, impacts, balloons, and attendance confirmation — fully_copy.
* City and office ambience — reference.
* Urgent electronic game music — reference.

### detailed_description

[Shot 1] At a bright weekday-morning ground-level metro station, <Subject 1> stands beside the doors of a stopped train.

Her phone announces:

<d>[Chinese] 还有二十四秒，你就迟到了。</d>

The doors open.

She immediately puts the phone into her shoulder bag and runs out.

The camera starts beside her and smoothly moves behind her right shoulder, following at approximately 1.5 meters.

HUD:
【主线任务：保住全勤】

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, <Subject 1> rushes through the open exit passage and spots a dark-green vintage city bicycle approximately 25 meters from the office.

The bicycle has a metal front basket, black saddle, extended rear passenger seat, conventional pedals and chain, and no motor.

The front saddle is empty.

<Subject 2> is already sitting sideways on the rear seat, looking at his phone and holding a steamed bun.

<Subject 1> does not recognize him as her boss.

She grabs the handlebars and shouts:

<d>[Chinese] 借一下！要迟到了！</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, <Subject 1> jumps onto the empty front saddle and immediately pedals away.
